title: SEP-41 balances are running sums of four event names, so a token that used other event names before a WASM upgrade is served a negative balance
severity_basis: sep41_balances is a running sum of transfer, mint, burn and clawback events with no starting value from contract storage and no check against it, and the column takes a negative sum; the API serves the stored value. A token whose balance changes were published under other event names (here: before a WASM upgrade) gets a wrong stored balance, and a negative one after its first standard transfer out: a silent wrong balance served to clients. Only the emitting token's own balances are affected (events count only for the contract that emitted them), so a contract can make wallet-backend serve wrong balances only of its own token, not of any other asset: medium, not high. The issue was filed in public.

entries.expected: a SEP-41 balance served by the API matches the token's [Balance, addr] contract storage and is never negative
entries.observed: No corpus entry holds this token's ledgers. By hand at 3e22515a on mainnet ledgers 65,293,184 to 65,293,433 of token CBAPZAZNNB4X3VPXV2LYA5RMV7XHXIVREES2GG7R5GUXDZ4R4CKOY4EU: sep41_balances and the GraphQL SEP41Balance edge give -88425026799475 for holder GCAETBNBFKVGLYFXKCLMKT6ZVHFXHRSDFSEW7ODIUJYC6R7H2QJ6OKGU, whose [Balance, addr] entry holds 895,464,242,420,347.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. At wallet-backend 3e22515a, the issue's steps (migrate up; the token's protocol_wasms, protocol_contracts and contract_tokens rows inserted by hand; protocol-setup --protocol-id SEP41; ingest over mainnet ledgers 65,293,184 to 65,293,433 served through the RPC interface; protocol-migrate current-state --start-ledger 65293184; serve) store and serve -88425026799475 for the holder, exactly minus the two standard transfers out after the WASM upgrade at ledger 65,293,237.
evidence.expected_basis: The token's own contract storage: the holder's [Balance, addr] contract data entry in the meta of ledger 65,293,433 holds 895,464,242,420,347. A token balance cannot be negative.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made at 3e22515a before filing on 2026-11-18: the SEP41Balance edge is -88425026799475 with the built-in hidden list and absent with a hidden-contracts file that lists the token.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-18 as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/824; this record restates the public issue.
